chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch.93: Shrouded Wraith Fight - Xiao Chen Trapped
chapter_meta_description: In the dead city's narrow alleys, Xiao Chen and Liu Mu battle a regenerating shrouded wraith. Their combined techniques may not be enough to survive.
og_title: World of Immortality - The Shrouded Wraith Battle
og_description: In this chapter of World of Immortality, Xiao Chen and his group encounter a regenerating undead wraith wrapped in a death shroud. The battle pushes their teamwork to the limit as they fight for survival in the City of the Dead.
